label: 6N cross-asset 5-day daily mean reversion overnight (Friday shorts true 5R) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `ZB 5-day daily mean reversion overnight (Friday shorts true 5R)`. Local mutation of Daily Tsmom Next Overnight; filter: short signals on weekday 4. Uses true bracket stop/target management at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection.
verificationSummary: Cross-asset strict PF 2.12 over 99 trades; average planned RR 4.99, min planned RR 4.66; bootstrap p05 1.38, block-bootstrap p05 1.30, annual pass rate 60%.
